change_summary: QA seed — initial OHSR sample clauses for WorkSafeBC PDF compliance testing

clauses.regulation_text: A worker must be protected from falling where the worker could fall 3 m (10 ft) or more, or where a fall from a lesser height could result in serious injury. Fall protection systems include guardrails, safety nets, and personal fall arrest systems.
Workers must wear head protection meeting CSA Standard Z94.1 in areas where there is a danger of head injury from falling, flying, or thrown objects.
Before excavation begins, the employer must ensure underground utility locations are identified. Excavation walls must be supported or sloped to prevent cave-in.
Work areas must be kept clean and orderly. Exits and access routes must be kept clear of obstructions at all times.
